name: Maximum-Parent Profile
definition: For a nonempty proper positioned binary class $C\subsetneq\{0,1\}^X$, let $\mathcal F(C)$ be the set of pairs $(r,s)\in\mathbb N_0^2$ for which $C$ is a marked coordinate section of a proper maximum class of rank $r$ on exactly $r+s+1$ coordinates. Equivalently, $s$ is the rank of the complementary maximum class and the auxiliary count is $r+s+1-|X|$.
normalization: Visible coordinates, including constants, remain part of the positioned class. The invariant is recorded here for nonempty proper maximum-generated classes.
comments: Complementation transposes the profile. Its finite antichain of coordinatewise minimal points determines the entire profile.
